80x15.title: Mainsite Badge
80x15.commentary: This badge contains a replay of a simple untimed snake game. It's one of those things that would take 15 (gruelling) minutes to do by hand, and a measly 90 minutes to automate!

80x15.title: 1024x768 Resolution
80x15.commentary: This entire site has responsive design for small screens, but the intended viewing resolution is 1024x768. HiDPI is completely unaccounted for.

80x15.title: Firefox
80x15.commentary: Firefox (rather, Librewolf) has been my browser of choice for double-digit years. I can't think of a single reason I'd rather use a Chromium fork.

80x15.title: RSS Validated
